title: 3.3 Salt Lake City Seventh Ward Relief Society, Minutes, January 4 and 28, 1868
book: The First Fifty Years of Relief Society
notes: 119 primary documents; Church Historians Press; EN-only

footnotes.text: The eleven wards were the First, Second, Third, Fourth, Fifth/Sixth, Seventh, Eighth, Tenth, Eleventh, Twelfth, and Fourteenth Wards. Membership of the Fifth Ward had been incorporated into the Sixth Ward in July 1860, and the two wards functioned as one unit until around 1877. The Fifth Ward Relief Society was organized September 4, 1877. (Presiding Bishopric, Bishops Meeting Minutes, 1851–1884, CHL, “Bishops’ Record from Feb. 1862 to Nov. 1879,” Jan. 16, 1868; “History of the Salt Lake City Fifth Ward,” comp. Andrew Jenson, in Fifth Ward, Temple View Stake, Manuscript History and Historical Reports, 1849–1964, CHL.)
